MJ.AideCours: One share = one day of food for one person. The rate helps trading; it is not money.
MJ.AideTroc: Without “go ahead”, the trade only happens if the trader finds it worth it at the rate, marked up by their first trust. Prejudices: those of the NPC that you say are roused by the group.
MJ.Accueillir: The group hosts it at its shelter

Savoirs.PreparationFaite: Everything is brought in or tied down ({fait} / {requis} person-watches): +1 protection, nothing will blow away.

Vents.retour: The wind comes back from the other side

Savoirs.Aide: The two kinds of know-how (modern, lontan), the elders, the dog and the cyclone. Each evening session takes a watch.
Savoirs.AideGramoune: One of the island's gramounes (elders), offered as a recruit: of mixed heritage, frail, wise. Recruiting is still a Speech test.
Savoirs.AidePreparer: Bring in or tie down whatever can blow away: 2 person-watches, plus 1 per exposed installation. Good for five days: +1 protection, nothing is carried off.
Savoirs.AideApprendre: A book: 14 evenings (and light). Someone who knows: 7. A gramoune who trusts you (3 or more), for a lontan skill: 4. Her notebook: 7.
Savoirs.AideDicter: Six evenings, if she trusts you (3 or more): a unique notebook that outlives her.
Savoirs.AideChien: One evening = 1 food and a Survival test (+1 die with Animal husbandry). At trust 5, the dog belongs to the group.

Aide.epreuve: They hold on by enduring (hunger, wounds, the cyclone).
Aide.refaire: They hold on by building and welcoming.
Aide.vivre: They hold on through small pleasures (a good meal, rest, a celebration, their passion).

Esprit.SensAide: From red (exclude, betray) to blue (welcome, help). Everyone sees their own; others know it by reputation.
Esprit.ReputationAide: What witnesses saw and repeated. It may be false.
Esprit.AutoriteAide: How much people listen when they lead: rises when they keep their word and everyone eats, falls when they ignore a vote.
Esprit.PratiqueAide: Practising: their morale can climb higher, but they must keep their observances. Not practising: little gain, no risk.

Projet.ailleurs: Wants to leave and found a better elsewhere

Communaute.Aide: The leader, harmony, the group's true colour (only you see it), the door, votes, tributes. Nothing is magical: faith works through morale.

Projet.ailleurs: {nom} is revolted by what they saw and wants to leave and found a better elsewhere. Who might quietly help: {complices}.

Communaute.Reputation: What people say of the group
Communaute.Trahir: Take what they bring, then send them away
